title: Apple will no longer report iPhone numbers after sales went to 0%, and analysts are worried the era of iPhone growth is over (AAPL)
text: Apple will no longer report iPhone numbers after sales went to 0%, and analysts are worried the era of iPhone growth is over (AAPL) By Jim Edwards Nov 2, 2018, 6:51 am 55 pts Apple will no longer report iPhone sales numbers. The move can only be interpreted negatively.
